notes: 19 endpoint entries. 18 are new route methods in 14 route files (system-design §3.3). 1 is the existing POST /api/internal/email/dispatch, whose contract is unchanged; it gains two maintenance calls (FR-18, FR-30, FR-35).
Base path is /api (existing convention), not /api/v1. Envelopes, error codes and pagination come from src/server/http.ts. Only GET /api/courses/:id/quizzes is paginated.

Decimals are fixed2 strings in all responses. Student and parent payloads come only from serializers.ts (toStudentQuiz / toStudentAttempt / toStudentResult); `correct`/explanation appear only in StudentResult when resultsVisible && showCorrectAnswers (NFR-1).
Contract decision: the manual grade body field is `pointsAwarded` (PRD API table), not `points` as written in system-design §3.2. manualGradeSchema must use pointsAwarded.

Contract additions inside existing design elements: StudentAttempt.serverNow (timer skew correction, display only); ManagerQuiz.locked/publishProblems/totalPoints; POST /attempts returns 201 on create and 200 on resume; submit is idempotent and returns StudentResult.
No HTTP endpoint for getStudentQuizScore (TS export for PRD-11), the grading workspace reads, the analytics page reads, or the accommodations list. Server pages call the services directly.
Stale leftovers from SH-9: artifacts/architect/threat-model-notes.json, artifacts/dev-planning/* and artifacts/dev/* must be regenerated for SH-10, not reused.
devGates: NFR-4 / ADR-7: dev must reach mui-mcp (useMuiDocs → fetchDocs) before writing any UI component; if it is unreachable, stop and report. This does not block dev-planning.
ADR-2: the partial unique index quiz_attempt_one_in_progress_uq is raw SQL in the migration. Dev and CI must use prisma migrate, never db push.
